title: An ALNS Heuristic for Large-Scale Line Planning with Mode Choice and Line Generation
summary: Demand responsiveness is an important consideration in public transport line planning, as network design and service quality influence passenger demand. However, accounting for this interaction further complicates an already challenging combinatorial optimization problem. To address this challenge, we propose a scalable Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search (ALNS) algorithm for large-scale line planning with endogenous demand.
